item.tib: stag ri rong gi nor gyi sgrub chung
item.coloph: dang po gshen rab ston pas mdzad/ stong rgyung mthu chen gyi thugs kyi bcud/ hris pa gyer med spyod pa'i las/ de nas dmu gshen dran pa bdag gis kyang / phyi rabs don du gter du sbas/ dam med lag tu ma shor cig phri phral spar ya thum/ (?)phyis dpon gsas khyung rgod rtsal gyis gter zhal phyes//
